natal.pageDescription: Build your natal chart online: planets in signs and houses, the Ascendant and aspects, from your date, time and place of birth.
natal.lead: Enter your date, time and place of birth and the chart is built right here. Nothing is sent anywhere: the calculation runs in your browser.
natal.name: Name
natal.tzHint: Time zone in IANA format (Europe/London, America/New_York). It accounts for daylight saving and historical clock changes on the date of birth.
natal.footnote: This is a starting point, not a finished reading: tie planet, sign and house together yourself, following the study plan. More on planets, signs, houses and aspects.
natal.noResults: Nothing found — try another spelling or enter coordinates manually
natal.errPlace: Pick a city from the suggestions or enter coordinates and a time zone manually.
natal.title: Natal chart
natal.porphyry: · Porphyry houses (Placidus is undefined beyond the polar circle)
natal.unknownCaption: Birth time unknown: the Moon may be off by up to ±7°; houses and the Ascendant are not calculated.
natal.readAsc: Ascendant {signIn} — how people see you when they first meet you: {key}.
natal.readElements: Elements (the luminaries count double): {list}. The dominant element sets the chart's overall temperament; the missing one is what you have to learn.
natal.readTight: Tightest aspects: {list}. The tighter the aspect, the louder it sounds in the character.
natal.copied: Link copied. The birth data is stored in the link itself.
natal.copyManual: Copy the address from the browser's address bar.
natal.legend: Red lines are challenging aspects, blue ones harmonious.
natal.legendNoHouses: Birth time unknown — houses not calculated.
